meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 装上后,容器里的 Bash 命令会自动经 rtk 代理转发,git、cargo、pytest 等开发命令的 token 消耗可降低 60–90%。不需在 CLAUDE.md 里写任何指令,Claude 照常跑命令,只是拿到压缩后的输出。
howto.when: 在把 rtk 装进目标 agent group、写好 PreToolUse 钩子并重启容器后生效。此后 Claude 在容器里每一次 Bash 工具调用都会被钩子自动接管,无需额外触发词。

say.note: 命令会先经 rtk 过滤再返回结果

say.text: 跑一下 pytest,把输出给我
say.note: 命令输出被 rtk 压缩后返回

say.text: 执行 rtk gain,看省了多少 token
say.note: 显示累计的 token 节省统计

howto.what_en: Installs the rtk proxy into the agent container and adds a Claude Code PreToolUse hook, so every Bash call is filtered through rtk. Commands like git, cargo and pytest return 60–90% fewer tokens.
howto.when_en: Takes effect after rtk is installed into the target agent group, the PreToolUse hook is written and the container is restarted. From then on the hook intercepts every Bash tool call automatically.

say_en.note: The command is filtered through rtk first.

say_en.text: Run pytest and show me the output
say_en.note: Output comes back compressed by rtk.

say_en.text: Run rtk gain to see tokens saved
